title: Rural Home Loans Escrow Waiver Fee
content:
**Fee clause.** The escrow waiver fee on a Rural Home Loans loan is the product's escrow waiver fee percentage of the principal balance on the loan record, rounded to the cent.

## The fee as a definition

The principal balance on the loan record, multiplied by the product's escrow waiver fee percentage and divided by 100; the result rounded to the cent, rounded only at the end. The percentage is the one in the product's escrow account terms.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, a fee percentage of 0.25)

| Principal balance | Fee |
|---|---|
| 240000.00 | 600.00 |
| 187321.45 | 468.30 (468.303625 rounded) |
| 96000.00 | 240.00 |

## Basis Q&A

**Which balance?** The principal balance on the loan record when the waiver is recorded.

**Is the fee charged once or yearly?** Once, on the waiver.
